component.name: ILOverlayFeedRequest
component.script: sub answer() if m.top.control <> "run" then return request = m.top.request if request.kind = "plan" ' Tests read the last URL sent here: the component publishes no URL that carries a grant. if not m.global.hasField("lastPlanUrl") then m.global.addField("lastPlanUrl", "string", false) m.global.lastPlanUrl = request.url return end if m.top.result = { sessionId: request.sessionId, revision: request.revision, status: 200, body: formatJson({ continueUrl: "https://ads.example/cart", qrImageUrl: request.url + "/qr/" + request.variantId + ".png" }) } end sub
